description: The photographer's details: name, one-line introduction, contact, portrait and the About page story. The collection holds one object; every page reads from it.

id.label: ID
id.help: Always 'info'. The templates look the object up by this ID, so leave it alone.

name.label: Name
name.help: The name on the site: a person or a studio. Shown in the title band, the footer and page titles. Shorter names look better at display size.

tagline.label: One-Sentence Introduction
tagline.help: One plain sentence beside the name on the home page: what you shoot and where.

base.label: Home Base
base.help: Where you are based, e.g. North Cascades, Washington. Shown in the footer and on the Contact page.

email.label: Email
email.help: Public email address, shown on the Contact page and in the footer.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: Public phone number. Leave empty to hide it everywhere.

instagram.label: Instagram Link
instagram.help: Full address of your Instagram profile. Leave empty to hide the link.

responseTime.label: Reply Time
responseTime.help: What to expect after someone writes, e.g. I reply within two working days. Shown on the Contact page.

portrait.label: Your Portrait
portrait.help: A photo of you at work, for the About page. Portrait orientation works best.

intro.label: About Page Introduction
intro.help: Two or three sentences at the top of the About page.

story.label: Your Story
story.help: The rest of the About page: how you got here, how you work, what a session feels like. Three or four short paragraphs.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.
